sections.title: Sea Chart
sections.note: 49 squares, A1 in the north-west to G7 in the south-east. Bait comes from Beedle's shop ships.

items.name: A1 Forsaken Fortress
items.howTo: Already charted when the King of Red Lions gives Link the Sea Chart; tick it. Its fishman still trades a hint for bait.
items.notes: Here: a Piece of Heart, Treasure Chart 25's treasure.

items.name: A2 Star Island
items.howTo: Sail near Star Island until the fishman leaps out of the water and throw him All-Purpose Bait; he fills in the square.
items.notes: Here: a Piece of Heart, Treasure Chart 7's treasure, a secret cave, lookout platforms.
